title: Office & Commercial Movers in Glendale | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Commercial movers in Glendale: SOS Moving plans office relocations and IT relocation services in Glendale, CA around your building access window.
heroSubtitle: Office relocations planned around your building access window — any day of the week, 8AM – 6PM

faq.question: Will you send a certificate of insurance to our building manager?
faq.answer: Yes. The certificate costs $50, is written to the wording your property manager sends over, and reaches the management office before move day rather than on the morning. Forward us the building requirements as soon as your date is set.

faq.question: Can our office move happen over a weekend?
faq.answer: Crews work Saturday and Sunday inside our normal hours, Monday – Sunday, 8AM – 6PM. Friday through Sunday runs at a higher hourly rate, so many clients keep the bulk stages on a weekday and save the weekend for floors that cannot be cleared while staff are working.

faq.question: How much do commercial movers in Glendale cost?
faq.answer: Two movers and a truck are $119 an hour in cash or $129 by card Monday through Thursday, and $135 or $145 Friday through Sunday. Three- and four-mover crews step up from there, gas adds $30, and every job carries a three-hour minimum with drive time doubled past 10 miles. The firm figure follows a walkthrough.

faq.question: Where does the truck stand for a move in downtown Glendale?
faq.answer: At the loading zone or dock your building assigns, booked in advance with management. Crew cars go to a city garage such as Marketplace, Exchange or Orange Street, where the first 90 minutes are free and the rate runs $3.00 an hour up to $15.00 a day, and on-street parking is paid at a multi-space meter by space number.

faq.question: Can you move a small office at short notice?
faq.answer: Often, yes. Same-day work depends on a crew being free, so call 909-443-0004 early in the day. A suite of a few desks usually fits an existing schedule, while a full floor needs a walkthrough, a certificate of insurance and a booked elevator first.

faq.question: Do you take cubicles apart and rebuild them?
faq.answer: Yes. Panel systems are dropped, carried flat and rebuilt to the new floor plan by the same crew, and workstations go back together at the new address. Disconnecting and reconnecting computers is included once your Moving Coordinator adds it to the estimate.
